spec.name: sprint44_takerimb_cont_btceth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 15m taker-buy imbalance at quarter-hour opens predicts 60m continuation in BTC/ETH beyond T1 round-trip fees.
spec.power_argument: 2 symbols x cap 6/day => ~12 trades/day; >=300 validation trades in ~25 days. Assumed 60m net SD ~40bps => SE ~2.3bps at n=300; min detectable mean net edge ~7bps at t>=3. Null cannot pass t>=3; n<300 => UNDERPOWERED not FAIL.
